title: nan
authors: Yuan J.; Dai M.; Zheng E.; Su C.; Chen N.; Hu Q.; Zhu S.; Cao Y.
key_contribution: Presents SWA-PF, a semantic-weighted adaptive particle filter for memory-efficient 4-DoF UAV localization in GNSS-denied environments using UAV imagery and satellite maps, validated on a new dataset.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
